# The interpreter is the none language's and the none platform's: `sngl test`
# runs a program through it on `none`, and nowhere else. A platform with a
# generator of its own, given `--lang none`, has no tests to run.

sngl test app.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform none app.sngl
stdout 'ok'

! sngl test --platform fyne --language none app.sngl
stderr 'platform "fyne" does not support testing'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component counter() ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.button(text="{n}", @click { n = n + 1 })
}

func testCounts(t test.Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.n == 0)
}

ui.window {
    counter()
}
